messages:
partners-ops: Heads up — new reseller promo on the EU marketplace from DataCart scheduled week of Jun 12-19. Partner estimates ~120k GPU-hours over 7 days, peak concurrency ~800 pods (~40k tokens/s). They want p95 latency ~300ms and a hard cost cap. Need capacity + network egress check and a quick cost estimate. @leo @maya @sanjay

claire: Do we have a shape for the run? burst vs sustained matters. 120k over 7 days = ~7.1k GPU-hrs/day. If sustained that’s ~300 GPUs continuously; if bursty we may need ~800 for short windows. Need exact promo hours and models.

sanjay: Infra notes: eu-west1 has ~250 unreserved A100-equivalent GPUs right now. We can add spot pools for bursts but NLB/egress could be a choke. For ~800 concurrent pods, node packing + continuous batching is essential. Also watch NLB throughput. Example quick check:```
# kubectl top nodes | grep eu-west1
node-eu-1   1200m   38%
node-eu-2   1400m   44%
```
This is nominal, but sustained spikes pushed it last week.

maya: Also need model family. 70B fp16 will blow through GPU-hours vs a quantized 7B. If DataCart can use q4_0/q4_1 builds we can reduce GPU-hours ~2-3x depending on latency. Can provide perf deltas once we know model.

leo: I'll ping DataCart for model list + exact windows and ask about their cost cap. Quick ask: do we want to offer a reserved vs burst proposal?

claire: Yes — propose two options in the quote: 1) Reserved plan: reserve ~300 GPUs for duration (predictable, SLA-eligible). 2) Burst plan: reserve 200 + autoscale spot for peaks. Ballpark pricing to use for now: reserved A100-equivalent ~ $3.2 / GPU-hr, spot ~ $1.8 / GPU-hr. Egress: first 2TB included in marketplace listing, then ~$0.09/GB. I'll compile a formal breakdown.

ops-bot: Cluster alert (1812346200): eu-west1 NLB sustained throughput at 78% of target for last 10m. Recommend throttling tail requests or routing heavy flows to fallback region.

sanjay: If NLB is the risk, we should route heavy requests to eu-central as fallback. Cross-region fallback will add ~20-45ms extra latency; check if that fits SLO. Note: planned maintenance window Jun 15 02:00-05:00 UTC may reduce capacity — avoid scheduling the promo peak in that window or provide redundancy.

partners-ops: :thumbsup: Action items: @leo get models + exact timing from DataCart; @claire produce two cost options + GPU-hour breakdown and SLA caveats; @sanjay run capacity sim and confirm NLB headroom or fallback; @maya provide quantization/perf delta guidance. I'll book a 15-min sync Fri 09:30 UTC to finalize.

leo: Ack, reaching out to DataCart now. Quick Q from partner: are we comfortable offering 99.9% SLA for the one-week promo?

claire: 99.9% is doable but only with the reserved plan + cross-zone redundancy and can’t cover partner-side rate spikes that exceed agreed caps. I’ll add SLA language and failure modes to the quote.
